Lucy (Support): Hey team — ACME reports ~3% of users can't finish GitHub OAuth. They see "state_mismatch" after redirect; code present but exchange fails.

Lucy (Support): Customer-copied callback URL (from device):
```
https://app.acme.example.com/oauth/callback?code=SplxlOBeZQQYbYS6WxSbIA&state=eyJwcm9... (very long base64)
// their logs sometimes truncate to:
https://app.acme.example.com/oauth/callback?code=SplxlOBeZQQYbYS6WxSbIA&state=eyJwcm9...aW5n
```

Lucy (Support): They say state sometimes ends abruptly. Mostly on iOS Safari and some Android browsers. They suspect a CF worker or mobile redirect quirk.

Arjun (Eng): Classic mismatch if stored state != received state. Two suspects: client-side encoding/length or proxy trimming query params (Cloudflare worker, WAF). Any infra changes recently? Also check 4k url limits, header truncation.

Lucy (Support): Customer admits they serialize a lot into state (session stack). Attached request capture hitting our callback:
```
GET /oauth/callback?code=SplxlOBeZQQYbYS6WxSbIA&state=eyJwcm9...aW5n HTTP/1.1
Host: app.acme.example.com
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 16_4 like Mac OS X)
X-Forwarded-For: 34.12.123.45
X-Trace-Id: 8f1d2c4a-9b2f-4f3d-8a7a-0c9d5a2b6ae1
```

Lucy (Support): Our callback logs show received state length 462, but session had stored ~2048 chars. We reject with 400 state_mismatch.

Nora (Platform): CF workers and edge rules can drop or truncate long querystrings when rewriting. Some mobile browsers also change GET->POST on redirects. Any recent CF workers on their account? 

Arjun (Eng): Our routing unchanged. Customer runs Cloudflare + custom worker. Repro plan for support:
1) Run a tiny redirector to our /oauth/authorize with a giant base64 state (~3k).
2) curl -L to follow redirects and inspect callback query length.
3) Ask customer to capture the redirect URL via devtools or Charles proxy.

Lucy (Support): I did a quick curl against staging with nginx reverse proxy; nginx passes full querystring. Points to CF worker or browser.

Arjun (Eng): Short-term mitigation ideas:
- Add diagnostic headers on 400: X-Expected-State-Length and X-Received-State-Length.
- Consider accepting state via POST body (application/x-www-form-urlencoded) as fallback (temporary).

Nora (Platform): Agreed low-risk: add diagnostic headers and short-lived raw-querystring logging behind a flag (need privacy review).

SSO-Bot: Created INF-4621 for CDN/worker truncation triage: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4621 :spiral_calendar:

Lucy (Support): Customer wants ETA. Can we deploy diagnostic headers today and docs guidance about short nonces + server-side session?

Arjun (Eng): I can push headers to staging today (small middleware change). Raw querystring logging requires security sign-off; will ping Priya (security) — might take 24-48h.

Nora (Platform): I'll draft an OAuth best-practices doc update discouraging large state payloads and show example: store session server-side + use short opaque nonce.

Lucy (Support): Sharing workaround snippet I gave ACME:
```js
// short nonce
const state = crypto.randomBytes(24).toString('base64url');
// store sessionMap[state] = { ctx }
// redirect to /oauth/authorize?state=${encodeURIComponent(state)}
```

Arjun (Eng): Also check for double-encoding: extra percent-encoding can make edge rules see suspicious strings and truncate. Add a diagnostic marker in error body like "possible-edge-truncation" when percent-encoding looks abnormal.

Lucy (Support): I'll tell ACME: try the short-state flow and report. If still failing we'll escalate their Cloudflare worker and attach trace id 8f1d2c4a... to INF-4621. ETA for diag headers: EOD.

Nora (Platform): Followups:
- INF-4621 assigned to @arjun
- Docs PR from me tomorrow AM
- Security review: Priya

Lucy (Support): Thanks all — will update when ACME tests fix. :thumbsup:
